scope: all 62 GPT-assisted extraction raw DEV assertions and 9 raw status events

preserved_event_convention_diagnostic.alternative_replacement: same-turn explicit negative denial of old edge

temporal_and_epistemic_limits: The copied known_at is the source-turn availability time, not the API observation time or proof of the relation.
The raw extraction call saw the full three-turn case, including later corrections; historical queries over its graph are retrospective and do not measure prefix-only online extraction.
The compiler checks syntax, membership, exact quote and copied timestamp; it cannot by those checks prove semantic entailment or correction authority.
observed_source_assertion is a proposed epistemic basis, not a verified content fact. The two unsupported negative edges lack the stated source assertion despite their exact quotes.
All compiled content_truth fields remain unverified, including true positives; world truth is not measured.
Manual review used DEV source and DEV gold. No holdout generalization, causal superiority, or repeated model reproducibility is estimated.
Status convention diagnostic is preserved separately from primary event scoring; invalid grounding and cross-speaker overwrite are not excused as convention ambiguity.
No primary-score repairs, threshold changes, quote normalization, reruns or validation reads were performed.
